designDir.description: Folder with DESIGN.md, the generated tokens, components and screens, relative to this file.

screenDirs.description: Folders under designDir that hold screens.

stitchDir.description: Folder under designDir with Google Stitch exports (their source defaults to stitch).

archiveDirs.description: Folders under designDir with past experiments: archived by default, compared only among themselves.

catalogDir.description: Folder under designDir with the component catalog screen(s), the reference for consistency.

prefix.description: Prefix of meta tags (<prefix>-status), components (<prefix>-button, data-<prefix>) and CSS variables (--<prefix>-*).

order.description: Screen names in canvas order; the rest follow alphabetically.

comfortableTarget.description: Tap targets smaller than this (px) get a warning.

themes.description: The themes every screen must work in, by their data-theme value. Defaults to DESIGN.md's: dark (the plain colours), plus light when it has light-* colours. The canvas switches between them and check runs in each.

i18n.description: Languages. Screens mark product text with message keys (data-t, data-t-<attr>, data-t-args); the canvas switches language and check runs each screen in the pseudo-languages and the locales in check.

source.description: The language screens are written in.

locales.description: Locales with translations, besides the source language.

messages.description: Message files, relative to this file: JSON or a JS/TS module (default export, else its first exported object). A pattern with {locale}, or a map per locale with * for the rest.

check.description: Locales stitch2 check runs besides pseudo and pseudo-rtl, or "all".

rtl.description: Right-to-left locales, if not ar, he, fa, ur, ps and yi.

skills.description: Skill folders a blind-trial sandbox copies, relative to this file.

sandboxExclude.description: Paths under designDir a sandbox leaves out besides screens.

exports.description: Token files stitch2 tokens also writes for the app, so DESIGN.md drives the product too.

format.description: css: variables and .type-* classes; tailwind4: also an @theme block and @utility type-*; dtcg: W3C Design Tokens JSON.

path.description: Output file, relative to this file.

aliases.description: The app's variable names mapped to DESIGN.md colours ({"background": "floor"}) or CSS values.
